name: Chat system
ownerWords:
keep monitoring all the usage patterns of the Chat feature for that day, and periodically refine the framework so same stupid errors don't happen again.
now, this is a common patter, i want you to deep-research what to do. i want it to be owned by Chat though, maybe in a Cron/heartbeat tab within it with semantic goal defined
goal: Chats never sit stopped, never repeat themselves, and the owner never corrects the same thing twice. No bug seen in sieun-pi or prime-agent stays without a root fix and a test, or an open step. The spec rules hold: the sieun-pi server is a frontend-first wrapper around the prime-agent server, and prime-agent never needs sieun-pi to run.

onMiss: Start one job that reads the details file and judges each flagged item. Each problem gets a root fix with a test, or stays an open step that names the cause; a retry or a workaround does not close it. Route each fix: the chat brief (send the owner's words to the realtime layer thread), code with a unit test in components/user-history/test, or a skill. Everything flagged today is on the watch list for the next 7 days, so a recurred item means an earlier fix did not hold: reopen it. A sieun_pi_breaks item breaks the rule that prime-agent runs without sieun-pi. Each fix names the metric it must move. A recheck item is a fix(user-history) commit from the day before with today's value of the metric its subject names: if that metric still misses, the fix did not hold; reopen it. A repeat_corrections item is a correction in corrections.json the owner had to give again in that chat: a sev; its fix is code or a test, and the chat records it with correction_add id.
